Direction is unresolvable until news_search runs next trading day; preserve as the highest-priority next-cycle resolution item, not as a directional candidate.

Open question post-halt: is the -4.42% 1d a pre-event flush or early-exit on a thesis already priced into the +11.72%/20d run. QR-1 sources are tier-3 with ticker misattributions, reducing their weight.

Internal cluster correlation breakdowns (CRWD:NET 3.21σ, FTNT:NET 3.34σ, NET:PANW 3.28σ) suggest the cluster is fragmenting ahead of a potential cluster-wide reversal. Mean-reversion candidate to monitor post-halt; no flow corroboration available (options data zero, Saturday).

The same leverage driving the rally is the asymmetric downside if the geopolitical risk premium compresses. Binary-event-sensitive watch item; ceasefire-tape developments are the trigger.

Conviction is structurally capped by three simultaneous data gaps: yield curve unavailable (primary SCHW rate-income input), zero options flow (Saturday closure), and EMA trend zeroed from bootstrap. Re-evaluate when yield-curve macro data restores on next trading session.
